name: BlockSparseAttnBwd

q.description: 查询张量 (varlen 打包), shape (total_q, H, D); float16/bfloat16

k.description: 键张量, shape (total_k, HK, D), H % HK == 0; 与 q 同 dtype

v.description: 值张量, shape (total_k, HK, D); 与 q 同 dtype

dout.description: 输出梯度, shape (total_q, H, D); 与 q 同 dtype

softmax_scale.description: softmax 缩放, float 标量

exact_streaming.description: streaming 头是否用 token 粒度精确掩码 (仅因果), bool

q_lens.description: 各序列 q 长度, int 列表, sum == total_q

k_lens.description: 各序列 k 长度, int 列表, sum == total_k

sink.description: streaming 头 sink 块数 (exact 时为 token 数), int

local.description: streaming 头 local 块数 (exact 时为 token 数), int

dq.description: q 梯度, shape (total_q, H, D), 与 q 同 dtype

dk.description: k 梯度, shape (total_k, HK, D), 与 k 同 dtype (GQA 组内求和)

dv.description: v 梯度, shape (total_k, HK, D), 与 v 同 dtype

reference:
import torch

BLOCK = 128


def _ceil_div(x, y):
    return (x + y - 1) // y


def _gen_base_blockmask(B, nblk, nrow, ncol, sparsity, causal):
    bm = torch.zeros(B, nblk, nrow, ncol, dtype=torch.bool)
    for b in range(B):
        for h in range(nblk):
            s = sparsity
            if s != 0.0 and s != 1.0:
                for i in range(nrow):
                    idx = nrow - i - 1
                    avail = max(0, ncol - i) if causal else ncol
                    num_one = max(1, int(s * avail))
                    bm[b, h, idx, torch.randperm(avail)[:num_one]] = True
            elif s == 1.0:
                bm[b, h] = True
    return bm


def _streaming_keep_blocks(sq, sk, causal, device):
    nrow, ncol = _ceil_div(sq, BLOCK), _ceil_div(sk, BLOCK)
    ii = torch.arange(nrow, device=device).view(1, nrow, 1)
    jj = torch.arange(ncol, device=device).view(1, 1, ncol)
    if causal:
        start = max((sq - sk) // BLOCK, 0)
        mr = _ceil_div(max(sk - sq, 0), BLOCK) + 1 + (ii - start)
        valid_row = ii >= start
    else:
        mr = torch.full_like(ii, ncol)
        valid_row = torch.ones(1, nrow, 1, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    return jj, mr, valid_row


def _build_blocked_all(bs_head_idx, bs_ranks, blk_mask_b,
                       st_head_idx, st_sink, st_local,
                       sq, sk, is_causal, exact_streaming, H, device):
    has_bs = bs_head_idx is not None
    has_st = st_head_idx is not None
    if not is_causal and not has_bs and not has_st:
        return None
    blocked = torch.zeros(H, sq, sk, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)

    if has_bs:
        bm = blk_mask_b[bs_ranks]
        bm = bm.repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 1).repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 2)
        blocked[bs_head_idx] = ~bm[:, :sq, :sk]

    if has_st:
        if exact_streaming:
            row = torch.arange(sq, device=device).view(1, sq, 1)
            col = torch.arange(sk, device=device).view(1, 1, sk)
            ns = st_head_idx.numel()
            sink = st_sink.view(ns, 1, 1)
            local = st_local.view(ns, 1, 1)
            blocked_st = torch.logical_or(
                col > torch.minimum(row + sk - sq, torch.full_like(col, sk)),
                torch.logical_and(col < row + sk - sq - (local - 1),
                                  col >= sink))
            blocked[st_head_idx] = blocked_st
        else:
            jj, mr, valid_row = _streaming_keep_blocks(sq, sk, is_causal, device)
            ns = st_head_idx.numel()
            sink = st_sink.view(ns, 1, 1)
            local = st_local.view(ns, 1, 1)
            ncol = _ceil_div(sk, BLOCK)
            win = (jj >= (mr - local).clamp(min=0)) & (jj < mr.clamp(max=ncol))
            keep_blk = valid_row & (win | (jj < sink))
            keep_blk = keep_blk.repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 1).repeat_interleave(BLOCK, 2)
            blocked[st_head_idx] = ~keep_blk[:, :sq, :sk]

    if is_causal:
        row = torch.arange(sq, device=device).view(1, sq, 1)
        col = torch.arange(sk, device=device).view(1, 1, sk)
        blocked |= col > row + (sk - sq)
    return blocked


def run(q, k, v, dout, softmax_scale, is_causal, exact_streaming,
        q_lens, k_lens, sparsity, sink, local):
    device = q.device
    total_q, H, D = q.shape
    total_k, HK, _ = k.shape
    assert k.shape == v.shape and k.shape[2] == D
    assert H % HK == 0
    assert q.dtype == k.dtype == v.dtype == dout.dtype
    B = len(q_lens)
    assert len(k_lens) == B
    assert sum(q_lens) == total_q and sum(k_lens) == total_k
    assert dout.shape == q.shape

    torch.manual_seed(3407)
    cu_seqlens_q = torch.tensor(
        [0] + list(torch.tensor(q_lens).cumsum(0)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    cu_seqlens_k = torch.tensor(
        [0] + list(torch.tensor(k_lens).cumsum(0)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    ns, nb = H // 3, H // 3
    head_mask_type = torch.tensor([0] * (H - ns - nb) + [1] * nb + [-1] * ns,
                                  dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    streaming_info = torch.tensor([sink, local] * H, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    max_q, max_k = max(q_lens), max(k_lens)
    nrow = _ceil_div(max_q, BLOCK)
    ncol = _ceil_div(max_k, BLOCK)
    base_blockmask = _gen_base_blockmask(B, nb, nrow, ncol,
                                         sparsity, is_causal).to(device)
    if exact_streaming:
        assert is_causal

    dtype = q.dtype
    G = H // HK
    scale = softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else D ** -0.5

    cuq = cu_seqlens_q.tolist()
    cuk = cu_seqlens_k.tolist()
    hmt = head_mask_type.tolist()

    is_bs = torch.tensor([t == 1 for t in hmt], device=device)
    is_st = torch.tensor([t == -1 for t in hmt], device=device)
    bs_head_idx = is_bs.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    st_head_idx = is_st.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    bs_ranks = (is_bs.cumsum(0) - 1)[bs_head_idx] if bs_head_idx.numel() else None
    st_sink = streaming_info[2 * st_head_idx] if st_head_idx.numel() else None
    st_local = streaming_info[2 * st_head_idx + 1] if st_head_idx.numel() else None
    bs_head_idx = bs_head_idx if bs_head_idx.numel() else None
    st_head_idx = st_head_idx if st_head_idx.numel() else None

    softmax_max = torch.zeros(B, H, max_q, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    softmax_sum = torch.ones(B, H, max_q, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    attention_in = torch.zeros(total_q, H, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

    for b in range(B):
        qs, qe = cuq[b], cuq[b + 1]
        ks, ke = cuk[b], cuk[b + 1]
        sq, sk = qe - qs, ke - ks
        q_b = q[qs:qe].float()
        k_b = k[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)
        v_b = v[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)
        S = torch.einsum('t h d, s h d -> h t s', q_b * scale, k_b)
        blocked = _build_blocked_all(
            bs_head_idx, bs_ranks,
            base_blockmask[b] if bs_head_idx is not None else None,
            st_head_idx, st_sink, st_local,
            sq, sk, is_causal, exact_streaming, H, device)
        if blocked is not None:
            S.masked_fill_(blocked, float('-inf'))
        m = S.amax(dim=-1)
        p = torch.nan_to_num(torch.exp(S - m.unsqueeze(-1)), nan=0.0)
        l = p.sum(dim=-1)
        P = torch.nan_to_num(p / l.unsqueeze(-1), nan=0.0)
        row_empty = (l == 0)
        m = torch.where(row_empty, torch.zeros_like(m), m)
        l = torch.where(row_empty, torch.ones_like(l), l)
        softmax_max[b, :, :sq] = m
        softmax_sum[b, :, :sq] = l
        o_b = torch.einsum('h t s, s h d -> t h d', P, v_b)
        attention_in[qs:qe] = o_b

    dq = torch.zeros(total_q, H, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    dk = torch.zeros(total_k, HK, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    dv = torch.zeros(total_k, HK, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

    for b in range(B):
        qs, qe = cuq[b], cuq[b + 1]
        ks, ke = cuk[b], cuk[b + 1]
        sq, sk = qe - qs, ke - ks
        q_b = q[qs:qe].float()
        k_b = k[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)
        v_b = v[ks:ke].float().repeat_interleave(G, dim=1)
        dy_b = dout[qs:qe].float()
        o_b = attention_in[qs:qe].float()

        S = torch.einsum('t h d, s h d -> h t s', q_b * scale, k_b)
        blocked = _build_blocked_all(
            bs_head_idx, bs_ranks,
            base_blockmask[b] if bs_head_idx is not None else None,
            st_head_idx, st_sink, st_local,
            sq, sk, is_causal, exact_streaming, H, device)
        if blocked is not None:
            S.masked_fill_(blocked, float('-inf'))
        m = softmax_max[b, :, :sq].unsqueeze(-1)
        l = softmax_sum[b, :, :sq].unsqueeze(-1)
        P = torch.exp(S - m) / l
        P = torch.nan_to_num(P, nan=0.0)
        delta = (dy_b * o_b).sum(dim=-1).transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(-1)
        dP = torch.einsum('t h d, s h d -> h t s', dy_b, v_b)
        dS = P * (dP - delta)
        dv_full = torch.einsum('h t s, t h d -> s h d', P, dy_b)
        dq_b = torch.einsum('h t s, s h d -> t h d', dS, k_b) * scale
        dk_full = torch.einsum('h t s, t h d -> s h d', dS, q_b) * scale

        dq[qs:qe] = dq_b
        dk[ks:ke] = dk_full.view(sk, HK, G, D).sum(dim=2)
        dv[ks:ke] = dv_full.view(sk, HK, G, D).sum(dim=2)

    return dq.to(dtype), dk.to(dtype), dv.to(dtype)
description:
block_sparse_attn_func 反向 —— MIT Han Lab Block-Sparse-Attention 的梯度 golden reference。 对标 mit-han-lab/Block-Sparse-Attention (基于 FlashAttention-2.4.2) 的 BlockSparseAttnFunc.backward。掩码语义见 BlockSparseAttnFwd。
反向 (fp32, FlashAttention 标准伴随, 逐序列):
    S = (q·scale) @ k^T, 掩码位置填 -inf
    P = exp(S - m) / l, 全掩码行 P=0 (m/l 为前向 softmax max/sum 统计量)
    delta = rowsum(o ⊙ dY)
    dP = dY @ v^T; dS = P * (dP - delta)
    dV = P^T @ dY; dQ = dS @ K · scale; dK = dS^T @ Q · scale
    dk/dv 按 GQA 组内求和收回 HK 头
reference 在 run() 内先派生掩码并重算前向统计量 (softmax_max/softmax_sum/attention_in), 再执行纯反向, solution 同样只接收叶子输入, 需自行重算。
派生输入过程 (reference 与 solution 必须按此完全相同的过程从标量配置派生, run() 内以 torch.manual_seed(3407) 固定随机性):
    cu_seqlens_q = [0] + cumsum(q_lens), cu_seqlens_k = [0] + cumsum(k_lens) (int32)
    head_mask_type = [0]*(H-2*(H//3)) + [1]*(H//3) + [-1]*(H//3) (int32, 1/3 streaming + 1/3 blocksparse + 其余 dense)
    streaming_info = [sink, local] * H (int32)
    base_blockmask [B, H//3, ceil(max_q/128), ceil(max_k/128)] bool, 逐 batch/头/行块生成: sparsity∉{0,1} 时第 i 行块 (自底向上) 在可用列块 (causal 时 ncol-i 个, 否则 ncol 个) 中随机保留 max(1, int(sparsity*avail)) 个 (torch.randperm); sparsity==1 全保留; sparsity==0 全掩码
